bounds: One mapped event, unchanged/changed/deleted provider version, clean/held link and current/retired owner. The sequential read-reconcile-project path reaches projection in two steps without fairness assumptions. Existing reconciler tests cover revision races and uncertain writes; this model does not prove provider availability or the live UI. The local revision is fixed in these cases; concurrent authorized local edits and provider mutations remain covered by the existing shared reconciler tests, not by NoProviderWrites in this model.
